use_cases: SaaS product launch landing pages with email capture
Pre-launch waitlist signups for new products
Creator tool announcements and community building
Email newsletter signup sections for digital products
Launch campaigns with social proof and trust indicators
ai_summary: A hero section component featuring a gradient bar design with integrated waitlist email capture functionality. Includes social proof through animated user avatars showing 2.4K waitlist members, responsive navigation with social media links, and glass-morphism styling with backdrop blur effects. Designed for SaaS and creator tool product launches requiring early adopter signup.
